pages.text: A Mechanical Press is a useful early station for components. A Mechanical Mixer works with a basin, and some mixing recipes need a Blaze Burner beneath it.$(br2)Start with manually supplied stations. Once they work, add transport and collection. This makes it easier to separate a recipe problem from a transport problem.
Later, Deployers and other components support sequenced assembly. Read the complete sequence in JEI so you know the order of operations and how many repetitions are required.

For basic ores, Crushing Wheels turn one raw material into one matching dust. Supported metals include iron, copper, gold, silver, tin, lead, zinc, nickel and platinum. Custom Ore Shards and related forms are optional later upgrades; see Ore upgrades at your own pace in chapter 7.
